Application Data.NAME: Smith's Hobby Shop
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith's Hobby Shop specializes in retail sales of a wide variety of hobby and model-building supplies, including plastic kits, paints, adhesives, tools, and accessories. The shop also offers instructional workshops on model-building and painting techniques, ensuring that safety protocols are strictly followed during these classes. The business maintains strong inventory control systems, conducts regular stock audits, and features a well-maintained storefront with clear aisles and proper lighting. Compliance with local fire and safety codes is prioritized to create a safe shopping environment.
